unknown_versions: omit version and record the limitation; never infer from unverified local filenames
limitations: A locally verified unsigned CI receipt binds files and reported checks; it is not a signed build provenance attestation.

Native and statically linked dependencies inside FFmpeg, Qt, OpenSSL, yt-dlp and WebView2 are not exhaustively enumerated. Included notices are not proof that every listed upstream component is linked.
Build tool versions describe the observed build environment. They are not added as application runtime dependencies unless independently present in the actual archive.
The externally installed Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime and operating-system frameworks are not distributed inside the portable release and are not reported as bundled components.
